concerns.text: FR‑007 requires exactly 20 warm‑up steps, but no task enforces this fixed value. The only related items are T010 (test) and T016 (implementation), which treat warm‑up as a configurable parameter. Add a task (e.g., T0XX) that sets `config.warmup_steps = 20` and validates the exact count, or a test that asserts the first dream phase occurs only after step 20.
Missing training entry‑point `code/train.py` (T059) prevents end‑to‑end execution and violates reproducibility (see Analyze report). Implement the CLI entry‑point and add a corresponding task.

Tasks T061‑T065 introduce new metrics (logical‑depth, salience‑based replay, metabolic‑cost, documentation updates) that are not referenced by any FR/SC in the specification, constituting scope creep. Either add corresponding FR/SC entries to the spec or remove/defer these tasks.

Contract validation tests (T009) only cover `training_config.schema.yaml` and `evaluation_result.schema.yaml`. The project defines additional contracts (dataset.schema.yaml, dataset_schema.schema.yaml, dream_event.schema.yaml, dream_sample_schema.schema.yaml, experiment_result_schema.schema.yaml, statistical_report_schema.schema.yaml, training_result.schema.yaml, artifact_hashes.schema.yaml) with no associated validation tasks. Add schema‑validation tests for each missing contract.
